This is a smaller update, but it addresses several important issues reported by our community—thank you to everyone who took the time to flag them. ❤️
Minor engine update with slight performance improvements.
Fixed mismatched Koushou (Negotiation) questions and answers.
Fixed a battle softlock involving the To Protect Arawasu skill.
Fixed rare input issues with controllers connected post-game launch in Tsuri (Fishing).
Fixed mismatched Nigeru (Escape) questions and answers, particularly in certain labyrinth areas.
Fixed an issue where Omikuji menu could softlock after making certain inputs.
Fixed an issue where the Takarakuji could reach negative days for the remaining day counter due to a bug with time progression.
Improved texture quality in the Tsuri minigame.
Thanks as always for helping us continue polishing Shujinkou! If you have questions or want to reach out, please find us at https://shujinkou.community.
Team @ Rice Games
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/41f7c3a955b70c0e3e57cb44b4fc90d272bae0e1.jpg"]

Check the Leaderboards menu from the Main Menu by going to the Extras section. Your ranks for various different statistics (26 types!) will be shown! Note that ranks will feel a bit outdated and low in total number for some time due to this feature being introduced late into release. We will make sure the next game has it all ready to go on launch!
We are aiming to eventually migrate data into a global database, allowing for you to compare your scores with players on other platforms.

🔥 Major Data Overhaul - Thanks to a series of major improvements regarding data infrastructure and architecture, future patches should be much smaller in size. The game's file size has also decreased by 5-10% (300+ MB).
Resolution of the game's loading screen has been improved on certain platforms.
Updated Shujinkou logo on the Title Screen.
Tatiana's minigame, Kotoba Kyuugi, has undergone extensive reworks regarding physics, collision logic, enemy AI, and game speed. The game should be more enjoyable to play and score points in.
Fix animation degradation in the backgrounds of Kendama Kombo.
Fix issue with background images not loading sometimes in certain circumstances while in the Kanban Menu.
Fix bug with Otogawa's Okkake no Osakenori waves, present during some runs and only on some platforms.
Fix bugged character in Town 2 at night.
Read more about this update on the official Rice Games website:
Team @ Rice Games
Bam! We're back, still alive as always, with d1.45 for the thousands of demo players out there! 🔥
This update packs 100+ fixes and improvements implemented over the past few months.
If you’ve been curious about Shujinkou but haven’t quite been ready to jump in, this is a great time to give the demo a fresh try and see how the game feels for yourself. ❤️

We wanted to share some notes on the upcoming versions, because although we have been behind schedule for a few weeks now, a lot of changes have been made to improve the game for the long term, and will be improvements that are included from the start for future games:
v1.46 - Leaderboards: Leaderboards will be fully implemented and working across all platforms, expected to release on or before September 9th 2026.
v1.46 - Fixes: We fixed a few degradations that our team didn't catch when releasing v1.45. We're sorry for the inconvenience, but the fixes will be up as soon as next week!

v1.47 - Addressable Rearchitecture: The way certain data and asset bundles are loaded and processed in the game have been improved. As a result, the game's overall executable/application size has been reduced by 3-5% (may be more), and future releases will introduce far smaller patch sizes.

v1.47 - Kotoba Kyuugi Revamp: The billiards minigame has been plagued with edge case issues and strange physics problems. While the minigame has not reached its ultimate form, the game's logic and physics has been rewritten, such that it's far easier to earn points, gain consecutive strikes, and have fun. The FPS in this minigame should also average above 60 FPS on standard devices moving forward too.
Have a great weekend!
Team @ Rice Games

items.text: Fixed an issue where D-pad was not really working super smoothly/reliably on Steam Deck. This wasn't an issue a few months ago and was traced to a non-Shujinkou bug with Unity, but we apologize for it taking so long to find and fix!

Fixed three Kanban facing the wrong direction in Labyrinth 9.
Add missing Kanakae Orb spot to a spot in the middle of Labyrinth 7's Area 1 containing new information about six kanji. It includes 18 new Blue Text terms. Our apologies!
Fix bug where players could not access certain hidden treasure chests in towns that were located adjacent to Exit to Nation spots.
Fix potential soft-lock for story progression in Labyrinth 10 if a player leaves the labyrinth after fulfilling specific conditions.
Fixed issue with incorrect description for the "tongue" kanji.
Fixed issue with Level Luck Tutorial not appearing for some players. See it by leveling any of the heroes up by one after clearing Labyrinth 1.
Fix low FPS when Reduced Effects is toggled off while in combat in Labyrinth 1.
Fix rare display bug with discovery percentages in the Item Compendium.
Fix rare display bug with discovery percentages in the Kanban Menu.
Fix sizing issue for English display of Cherry Pit item (Sabaku Arc).
Fix various reported issues with Okkake no Osakenori, including clipping bottles, unstable handling of the surfboard, and instances where the camera would not rotate upon reaching a turn.
Fixed several typos found in youkyuu, level loading tips, and more.
Fixed duplication of rows holding the same item in the Koukanya shop.
Improve the balancing of certain purchasable armor (stats have been improved) when entering Labyrinth 8.
We want to add a "Fast-Forward" (by holding a certain key) to some minigames so that they can be played and progressed through more quickly.
We've noticed some physics inconsistencies in Tatiana's minigame, Kotoba Kyuugi, and are looking to fix this soon.

We've noticed that when holding a button to move, then sliding your hand (while still holding the button) to another button occasionally does not allow the player to rotate properly in the dungeon. We are looking to fix in the near future.
Read more about this update on the official Rice Games website:
[p align="start"]We've got some small bugs addressed and fixed here:
Fixed a few typos and improved text found in quests.
Fixed inconsistent level progression for certain Arawasu skills.
Improved some wording for existing tutorials.
Adjusted DLC quest "Big Fluffy Clouds" balancing so that instead of having to fetch 20 quail eggs (Uzura no Tamago), the player only needs to fetch 8 eggs.
Optimizations that have led to a reduced application size by around 200 MB.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We're also honored to have recently been awarded Smart Game of the Year at Digitally Downloaded and ranked #27 in Noisy Pixel's Best Indie Games of 2025!
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","]
Smart Game of the Year at Digitally Downloaded
#27 in Noisy Pixel's Best Indie Games of 2025
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/4cea27a9776bffc948abc30a402b7d1e9846fef4.png"]

"I always approve of games that are both excellent to play and also educational in some way. That’s part of the reason that I love Civilization so much—over the years it has inspired me to look into all kinds of history.
I want to highlight Shujinkou for this too. An indie project driven by the passion of one person, Shujinkou is an excellent dungeon crawler in its own right.

But what makes it really noteworthy is that it will help you learn Japanese as well, with the text starting out in English and slowly changing to Japanese as you play on and learn new words. Inspired work."
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/cae30505fd4bd485c689fa162e06184c9684bc7d.png"]
"Shujinkou combines classic dungeon crawling with a Japanese language-learning layer that ties directly into combat without turning the game into homework.

Kana-based weaknesses, adjustable UI language options, and optional grammar explanations add real structure to how you approach encounters, and the JRPG side still carries its weight through turn-based strategy, strong music, and a long-form story.
It feels like a full RPG first, then a smart learning tool built into the rules."
[p align="start"]
The 2025 Winter Sale ends soon—don't miss out on a great chance to dive into the world of Shujinkou for a discounted price! ❤️
Best,
Team @ Rice Games

notes.title: Shujinkou Hot Patch - Steam Cloud Fix

items.text: This small update (linked build # included) fixes the Steam Cloud saving / loading issue that was reported by a lot of players. This new patch confirms working Steam Cloud and also includes the new menu called Steam Cloud Save Conflict Menu:
In this menu, you will have the option to play with locally stored save data or the last saved Steam Cloud save data.

As mentioned in the help text in the screenshot, please be warned that choosing one save data, then saving the game after that, will cause the other save data to be overwritten and permanently deleted. This also occurs when opening and closing the Option Menu in both the Main Menu and in the Party Menu.
Here is a zoomed-in image for those curious about the flow.

In the unfortunate event that you unintentionally overwrite the wrong save, please send an email with your Steam username to contact@ricegames.net with the subject title Recover Lost Save Data and we will see if there's anything that can be done to recover it.

releases.displayName: How to Access the Digital Artbook & Select Soundtrack

items.text: From the bottom of my heart, thank you so much for purchasing Shujinkou. The team and I are ecstatic to see you make your way through Genya and Sabaku, experiencing thousands of fun, terrifying, and emotional moments as you embark on this great journey. Please feel free to share your favorite moments as Screenshots, Artwork, or Videos in the Shujinkou Community Hub!
If you purchased the Shujinkou Deluxe or Super Deluxe Edition, you can access the Digital Artbook and Select Soundtrack by doing the following:
Head to Shujinkou in the Library
Find the Settings and click Properties
Go to "Installed Files"
Click "Browse"
There should be a Mac and Windows folder. Please click into the one that matches your OS and feel free to open the two special executables.
*If it isn't refreshing, try going to "Installed Files" and clicking the "Verify integrity of game files" button
Please note that there is support for downloading the Digital Artbook as a PDF and the Select Soundtrack as a zip of either WAV files or MP3 files (support for both types is available).
Please also note that there are some spoilers in the Digital Artbook. Specifically, the Environments, Enemies, and Story Illustrations sections! Beware!
Warm regards,
Julian Rice
Director, Producer of Shujinkou
*Art by Catthy Trinh (atelierailuros)

Adjust Tsuri (Fishing) algorithm so that the grade of the Bait that you select has a greater impact on how easy (or difficult) it is to fish up any kind of fish.

Polish all textual data for example words used in all Hiragana and Katakana Kanban so that the font doesn't become too small and so that it's legible even on smaller screens (like the Steam Deck).

Prevent menu scroll null exception error that would rarely take place if a player spammed inputs when leaving the game and returning to the main menu.

Hello! We've got a new patch released for the demo. Because we didn't post an announcement for the initial two patches, which took place on Day 1 and 2 respectively when the demo was released, the notes for those patches will be included here too.
Add "Reminder to Save" toggle option in Options Menu.

If enabled, the game will remind you after a few consecutive random encounters (if you have not saved) to save. If you say yes, the game will save immediately—this streamlines gameplay and grinding a bit and reduces the need to have to always go to the Party Menu to save.
If disabled, the game will not remind you to save.
When this appears in-game, you have the option to Snooze. Snoozing will automatically turn the toggle option OFF/disabled. You can adjust these settings again in the Options menu.
IMPORTANT: This setting is set to OFF/disabled if you already have existing save data.
Add "Visible in Background" toggle option in Options Menu.
If enabled, the game remains active when changing tabs/screens/monitors/apps.
If disabled, the game's app/music stops and/or disappears when changing tabs/screens/monitors/apps.
Implement up/down paging for the Kemono Kiroku (Bestiary)

Usually you can skip through (10 entries at a time) by pressing Left/Right, but now you can also press Down when on the last active button, and press Up when on the first active button, and that will automatically take you to the next page of enemies/akuma to view.
Miscellaneous

issues.text: We are aware of the following issues and are looking into solutions:
Lighting issues (areas are too bright) for a small subset of computers, specifically in labyrinths during Dusk and Night (sometimes Dawn), but also sometimes on the Nation Map.
Small maru (like in ぴ) may not appear on all instances seen in dialogue
Under certain circumstances, the Curse ailment does not always trigger in battle.

If you have fewer than 15 MB of free space left on your computer and you have Data Analytics enabled, a harmless pink crash may occur during battle once in a while. The solution to this is to free up some space on your computer, or disable Data Analytics via the Party Menu.
There may be a resolution issue when loading the game on Mac versions (unconfirmed).
